CARDIOLOGY CONSULT NOTE
Requested by: Dr. Amy Fontaine
Patient: Walter Briggs   Date of visit: 03/27/2026
Consultant: Dr. Luis Herrera, Cardiology

Reason for visit: palpitations

ASSESSMENT: Likely benign premature atrial contractions. No evidence of structural heart disease on exam.

RECOMMENDATIONS:
Order an echocardiogram and a 14-day event monitor.
Decrease caffeine intake.
Continue low-dose aspirin 81 mg daily.
Refer to electrophysiology if the event monitor shows sustained arrhythmia.

Return to our clinic in 6 weeks to review results.
